issue.title: Iceberg tables created with binary column using terraform is showing as unknown (type: varbyte) in Glue catalog
issue.body:
### Terraform and AWS Provider Version

```console
terraform --version
Terraform v1.15.5
on darwin_arm64
+ provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws v6.49.0
+ provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/random v3.9.0
+ provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/time v0.14.0
+ provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/tls v4.3.0
```

### Affected Resource(s) or Data Source(s)

* `aws_glue_catalog_table`

### Expected Behavior

Glue catalog should show binary column as binary type in glue catalog and binary in Athena Console

### Actual Behavior

Glue catalog is showing as unknown column type (varbyte) in glue catalog and varbyte in Athena Console

### Relevant Error/Panic Output

```console

```


### Sample Terraform Configuration

<details open>
<summary>Click to expand configuration</summary>

```hcl

```
</details>


### Steps to Reproduce

1. Create iceberg table having column with binary datatype using terraform aws provider latest version
2. check the  Glue catalog UI for that table (unknown type - click on that link - you will see type:varbyte)
3.  check the table in Athena Console left drop down (you will see varbyte)
